scope: E1 documentation, development EDA diagnostics and fold-index preparation; four static regularized linear references were specifically authorized for block-C residual EDA. DL training, tuning, pilot and benchmark remain reserved for E2 by user instruction; the original guide includes empirical requirements in E1.

target.definition: next value of historical rolling daily log-return standard deviation, not seven entirely future days

margin_reference: persistence on the same evaluation dates; operational criterion accepted by user, not calibrated financial utility

metric_policies.mape: positive true targets only; report coverage and zero exclusions; no arbitrary epsilon
metric_policies.mase: lag1 calendar day; denominator from permitted training only; undefined if zero/no valid pairs

independence: Temporal dependence; preserve paired dates and calendar. Final block length and seed design belong to E2.
missingness_policy: strict exclusion of incomplete daily OHLCV; no imputation; preserve missing calendar positions
selection_status: Provisional documentary candidates; final trio not closed. S1 winning hyperparameters recovered from Appendix C; library version/project adaptations and academic sufficiency remain unresolved.
unresolved: mandatory academic-database searches and applied-literature coverage
final extraction of three recurrent minimal-complexity DL baselines
academic adequacy of grey attention sources, unfixed keras-tcn version and incomplete source details in S6
use of exact dataset in prior literature
temporal inference unit and block length
implemented configurations, refit policy, pilot and benchmark in E2 user scope
final supervised test samples and experimental protocol
decision_timing: Operational definitions accepted before the planned experimental stage; development EDA already exists; this is not a complete experimental preregistration.
metric_margin_scope: Relative 5% improvement only versus persistence; distinct margins for DL pairwise power, equivalence and advanced-versus-DL comparisons remain unspecified.

chronological_embargo.scope: fold-index preparation only; does not set retraining cadence or establish independent labels

raw_test_reserve.construction: existing acquisition metadata only; zero raw test archives opened in this review

eda_general_extension.marginal_shift_reference: conditional complete-block permutation;14/28calendar days;2000permutations perlength;seed42;Holm12;not confirmatory or a joint distribution test

eda_temporal_extension.missingness_policy: strict exclusion; no imputation; calendar preserved
eda_temporal_extension.residual_diagnostic_scope: Exploratory ACF and Ljung-Box/Holm12; overlapping sigma7 targets, linear misspecification and drift can produce dependence; no automatic type change or lag/alpha/window selection.
eda_temporal_extension.not_an_e2_protocol: Static fitting and alpha are diagnostic choices, not frozen DL or benchmark configuration.

implementation_evaluation_review_2026110.power_question_separation: Detecting a practical-sized effect against zero differs from demonstrating relative gain above0.05; planning alternative and null boundary must match.
implementation_evaluation_review_2026110.seed_vs_time_scope: R counts training-seed repetitions conditional on fixed dates and procedure; temporal inference remains separate.
implementation_evaluation_review_2026110.mase_valid_scale_mask: Common training-defined positive-scale origins; report N_M and coverage.

benchmark_review_20261103.ranking_score: mean of per-run RMSE computed over pooled eligible date predictions, distinct from pooled seeds or ensemble RMSE
benchmark_review_20261103.configuration_vs_evaluation: baseline key n/D/h/data-protocol stable across phases; evaluation phase/year/cohort recorded separately
benchmark_review_20261103.baseline_selection: development only, frozen before test, currently no selected id
benchmark_review_20261103.descriptive_differences: ratio of per-run metric means; best/worst identified separately for RMSE and MAE
benchmark_review_20261103.DM_estimand: date-level squared loss, with seed policy pending; not the same estimand as mean seed RMSE or a5percent threshold claim
